scope: Current host actuator hover isolation and all-control browser input/travel; Relay U023 external relay package, real 3P socket, removable terminal plug, independent screw angles and native Grove connection. Appearance and input intent only.

hostCoverage.counting: Per-configuration checks; CoreS3 two buttons repeat in the DinBase configuration, not 147 unique physical controls.

limits: Stickers remain deferred until original artwork is supplied.
43 catalog models remain modeled; this batch does not promote whole products to verified.

Cap travel, Relay hidden PCB/contact/cavity/wall and trimmed lead detail include visual inferences. Finite ray/containment sampling and browser pixels do not prove manufacturing fit or real-device execution.

Relay terminal pins are physical labels, not simulated electrical continuity. Screw rotation does not model threads, axial travel, torque or clamping. Existing U023 LED documentation conflict remains unresolved.
StackChan hidden servo/head/cradle and fixture datums/intersections remain unresolved; no source shells or axes moved in this batch.
Preflight dev navigation and inconsistent hover screenshots are excluded; final evidence is from the frozen production build, real canvas mouse and normalized hover.
